answer: Creating fake identities costs real capital per account, so a Sybil swarm becomes prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot: each agent must lock a walnut-sized bond of tokens to register, and voting power scales with bond age and peer attestations. A garden of honest peers cross-validates newcomers, while an atlas of historical attestations tracks reputation drift, making each forged identity a costly, traceable liability rather than a free multiplier. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
